title: Collection of magical and other treatises ascribed to Hermes Trismegistus
shelf_note: An Arabic manuscript of a Hermetic lapidary and talisman text (stones engraved with zodiacal and planetary images, sayings of Hermes and 'Fontas'). It matches the title. The tradition and collections fields are empty.
structure_note: The structure count pages_translated is 0, but the book field pages_translated is 163, so one of the two counters is wrong (E2). On a manuscript, 20 printed backsteps and 12 repeats out of 63 'printed numbers' most likely come from misread folio marks or catchwords rather than a real disorder of leaves. This page carries no folio number, only a catchword. 3 pages have no OCR.

book_verdict: This is the right leaf, and its transcription and translation are largely sound. Two moderate misreads ('al-ḥamā' for what seems to be 'a red stone', 'teaching' for 'carrying') pass into the English. The notes are accurate but mostly decorative, and the cipher name and 'Fontas' are left without notes.
